chunks.title: Cisco (Cisco) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Cisco is a Strategic Corporate / COP31 Supporter headquartered in United States. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Climate Supporter (Digital Sustainability & Connected Smart Cities). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: COP31 Climate Supporter; Cisco Foundation climate regeneration grants & smart-city IoT infrastructure collaboration. Source verification: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: Cisco Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Cisco provides the following climate financing instruments: Strategic Tech Partnership, Cisco Foundation Climate Grant Referral, Cisco Investments CVC Referral. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 0 to USD 10,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Municipality, Accredited Entity/NGO.

chunks.title: Cisco Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Cisco: Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Climate-Tech Innovation, Air Quality & IoT, Circular Economy & Zero Waste. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Türkiye, Europe. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Cisco Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Cisco's application form: Distinguish COP31 Climate Supporter role from separate Cisco Foundation / CVC applications; Protect Level 3/4 proprietary AI architecture before NDA. Explicit exclusion rules: Assuming COP31 Supporter badge equals open investor commitment. Official application portal: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: Cisco Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Cisco uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
